text.enUS: Top of Gelkak's Key. The Top of Gelkak's Key is one of three shattered fragments of a mechanical key belonging to the shipwrecked gnome Gelkak Gyromast. After his vessel was lost off the coast of Darkshore, this jagged brass section was snatched up by a giant foreststrider roaming the nearby woods. When Gelkak Gyromast's ship was attacked and sunk by ravenous threshadons off the coast of Darkshore, the gnome washed ashore clutching the winding key meant for his mechanical first mate. The impact against the coastal rocks broke the instrument into three pieces. Before the dizzy pirate could gather his wits, the indigenous beasts scavenged the wreckage, with a giant foreststrider making off with this ornate upper portion into the misty forest.

Tor'kren Farm. Tor'kren Farm is a quiet, struggling swine farm in northwestern Durotar, near Thunder Ridge and the Southfury River. Misha Tor'kren tends the homestead while anxiously awaiting news of her son Kron, who has not returned from a hunting trip. Carving out a living from the dry, unforgiving red dirt of Durotar is never simple, but Tor'kren Farm has had a harder time than most. Situated southeast of Thunder Ridge, the homestead focuses on raising pigs in a rugged climate where feed and water are scarce. Unlike the bustling trade posts or heavily defended barracks of the Horde, the farm stands isolated and quiet, producing meager yields in the shadow of nearby bluffs.

Torch of the Dormant Flame. The Torch of the Dormant Flame is a ritual implement carried by young Horde shaman during their communion with fire in Durotar. Awaiting the defeat of a flame manifestation atop the mountain, it serves as a vessel meant to capture primal elemental fire upon the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. A shaman seeking the favor of fire is entrusted with the unlit Torch of the Dormant Flame before ascending the peaks above Durotar. After drinking a spirit-revealing fire sapta, the shaman sees and challenges a Minor Manifestation of Fire upon the mountaintop. Slaying this elemental spirit yields a glowing ember, which is deposited into the weathered brazier of the Shrine of the Dormant Flame. Touching the head of the dormant torch to the resulting white-hot conflagration awakens the wood, transforming it into a burning emblem of elemental mastery.

Torek's Assault. Torek's Assault is a direct Horde raid launched from the wilds of Ashenvale against the nearby night elf garrison at Silverwing Outpost. Led by the orc raider Torek under orders from Splintertree Post, the strike aims to crush local Sentinel resistance and slay their commander, Duriel Moonfire. It marks one of the most brazen, bloody skirmishes in the ongoing war for Ashenvale's borders. Ashenvale is locked in an escalating border war between the Horde lumber camps and the native night elves. Seeking to break the Alliance's defensive perimeter, Torek gathers a pack of Splintertree raiders just outside Silverwing Outpost. Rather than waiting for a counter-attack, Torek coordinates a head-on charge to shatter the outpost's defenses before the night elves can mount a reinforced campaign against Splintertree Post.

Tormus Deepforge. Tormus Deepforge is a dwarven smith working at the center of the Great Forge in Ironforge. A dependable craftsman, he coordinates iron deliveries and supplies armaments for Alliance defense efforts across Khaz Modan and beyond. Positioned right beside the roaring fires of the Great Forge, Tormus Deepforge oversees substantial metalworking tasks on behalf of the Bronzebeard clan. Beyond hammering steel himself, Tormus mourns his mentor, Sturgy Ironband, whose smithing compound south of Helm's Bed Lake in eastern Dun Morogh was overrun by Dark Iron dwarves after a load of strange umbral ore arrived there.
